baseline_models.focus_anchor: مِرْيَةٍ مِّن لِّقَآءِ رَبِّهِمْ ... بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ مُّحِيطٌ
baseline_models.mechanism: The verse opposes unstable doubt to a face-to-face convergence with their sovereign Lord, then answers apparent postponement with knowledge that takes in every knowable particular from every side.

activation_trace.role: Literal doubt and hesitation supply the subjects' unstable epistemic condition.
The convergence of two facing sides makes the doubted encounter concrete and relational.
Sovereignty and ownership identify the encountered party as the Lord who already has claim over them.
The whole gathers all parts without remainder.
Anything knowable or reportable is included as an object of the encompassing.
Complete cognitive seizure from every side answers the claim that the meeting can remain doubtful.

changed_reading.before: They doubt a future meeting, while God knows everything.
changed_reading.after: Their doubt concerns an unavoidable confrontation with the Lord who already holds every part of their reality in complete knowledge.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: إِنَّهُمْ فِى مِرْيَةٍ ... إِنَّهُۥ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ مُّحِيطٌ
baseline_models.mechanism: The grammar places them inside a local medium of wavering while placing every entity inside a larger circumference. Their doubt is therefore not an outside position from which divine encompassing can be assessed; it is a contained disturbance within it.

activation_trace.role: The split-root image of back-and-forth wave motion renders the state named by مِرْيَةٍ as a turbulent interior medium.
Bringing two ends together supplies the convergence that their wavering cannot indefinitely defer.
Totality makes the outer circumference exceptionless.
Literal surrounding supplies the larger container in which their smaller enclosure sits.

changed_reading.before: Doubt and divine omniscience are two adjacent propositions.
changed_reading.after: The verse spatially nests their wavering enclosure inside the Lord's exceptionless enclosure, making doubt an internal condition rather than an escape.

baseline_models.mechanism: The same enclosure that can imply surveillance or capture also has branches of cultivation and protective custody. The possessive ربهم keeps an ongoing relation in view, so the encounter can carry care and completion without canceling judgment.

activation_trace.role: Meeting supplies direct relational arrival rather than merely remote information.
Repair, nurture, and completion make lordship an active cultivation of those met.
The care extends to the complete field rather than a favored fragment.
Guarding and protective attendance keep a live care-valence inside the encompassing.

changed_reading.before: The final encompassing is only threatening surveillance before judgment.
changed_reading.after: The encountered Lord surrounds every entity in an ambiguous custody that includes nurture and preservation as well as exposure and judgment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The early refusal is materialized as turned sides, protected covers, weighted ears, and a barrier. The final enclosure reverses their geometry: every device by which they claim insulation is itself inside the larger circumference.

activation_trace.role: Turning one's side supplies the initiating bodily refusal.
A protective covering supplies the claimed enclosure around the heart.
Weight in the ear turns non-hearing into a self-described material blockage.
A screening barrier supplies the imagined separation between hearer and messenger.
The final doubt is the epistemic interior produced by those refusals.
Total surrounding subsumes all the smaller covers and barriers.

structural_cues: 41:4-5 moves from turning away to coverings, ear-weight, and an interpersonal barrier; 41:54 closes with an exceptionless outer enclosure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a chain of physicalized barriers and the final surrounding; I infer a container reversal in which the latter encloses the former. A live alternative is that محيط names knowledge without spatial polemic.

changed_reading.before: They happen to doubt despite a generally available message.
changed_reading.after: Their doubt is a manufactured interior of covers and barriers, yet those barriers cannot place them outside the One who surrounds every thing.

context_deltas.mechanism: Creation is presented as measured, completed, and internally apportioned, including an order for each heaven. Thus every thing is not an undifferentiated mass under a static gaze; each particular is held in a differentiated economy of measure, completion, and nurture.

activation_trace.role: Measuring a created thing supplies designed proportion at the start of the cosmic sequence.
Deliberative apportionment supplies ordered provision rather than generic control.
Perfecting and carrying an act through supplies completed cosmic differentiation.
Each heaven is a bounded whole receiving its own command.
Nurturing and completing identify the Lord as administrator of the measured particulars.
The final totality gathers those differentiated wholes.
Complete comprehension holds every measured part together without erasing its assignment.

structural_cues: 41:9-12 moves from creating earth through measured provisions to seven completed heavens and an امر for each heaven.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measurement, completion, and per-heaven assignment; I infer that total encompassing preserves rather than flattens differentiation. It could instead be only a creation prelude unrelated to the final adjective.

changed_reading.before: God encompasses a flat collection called everything.
changed_reading.after: The Lord encompasses every thing as a precisely measured and completed particular within an ordered whole.

context_deltas.mechanism: At the gathering, hearing, sight, and skin cease to be private containers and become articulate evidence. The meeting in 41:54 is therefore embodied and juridical: the self arrives with its own components already disclosed, while the destructive error was supposing that God knew little of its acts.

activation_trace.role: Testimony as informed disclosure gives the body evidentiary force.
The body's enclosing skin becomes one of the witnesses rather than a screen.
Speaking indication turns bodily material into an intelligible disclosure.
Disclosure to the knower directly supplies the knowledge they underestimated.
Unreliable supposition names the error that God's knowledge was limited.
Face-to-face convergence gives this evidentiary disclosure its terminal encounter.
Every reportable component of the person falls within the evidentiary field.
Complete knowledge explains why no bodily or behavioral remainder can stay private.

structural_cues: 41:19-23 sequences gathering, bodily testimony, divinely enabled speech, failed concealment, false estimation of knowledge, and ruin.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gathering and articulate bodily witnesses; I infer that لقاء is a juridical encounter with the disclosed self. A live alternative is an encounter of judgment without a formal evidentiary scene.

changed_reading.before: An abstract person will someday meet an all-knowing Lord.
changed_reading.after: They meet their Lord as embodied records whose own enclosing surfaces have become witnesses within His complete knowledge.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact كل شيء frame first closes a revival argument with power, then the next ayah uses the meeting root for being cast into fire. The final لقاء is consequently neither an unrealizable abstraction nor neutral arrival: power restores the dead, and encounter opens onto assigned outcome.

activation_trace.role: Reviving dead earth supplies the visible model for restored life.
Loss of life supplies the condition that divine power reverses.
The repeated totality frame links universal power to the final universal encompassing.
Every possible object falls within the asserted power to revive.
Effective capability supplies the means by which the doubted meeting becomes possible.
Being cast supplies a directional consequence within the same root field as meeting.
The final convergence gathers revival and consequence into encounter with the Lord.
Complete comprehension leaves no gap in the power-to-outcome chain.

structural_cues: 41:39 ends with على كل شيء قدير; 41:40 contrasts being cast into fire with arriving secure on resurrection day; 41:54 ends with بكل شيء محيط.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies revival, universal power, casting, secure arrival, and universal encompassing; I infer a causal arc from power through resurrection to differentiated encounter. The alternative is that the repeated formulas are parallel attributes without a single arc.

changed_reading.before: Meeting the Lord is merely a future proposition they question.
changed_reading.after: Universal power makes the meeting bodily possible, while the intervening casting/secure-arrival contrast makes it an encounter with differentiated consequence.

context_deltas.mechanism: Knowledge of the Hour is joined to fruit crossing out of its sheath and gestation crossing into birth. Encompassing every thing is thus processual: it holds concealed states, visible emergence, and the transition between them, including the otherwise concealed approach of the meeting.

activation_trace.role: Knowledge as disclosure spans both the returned Hour and the hidden life processes listed under His knowledge.
Bringing a thing out of concealment supplies the hidden-to-visible transition.
The plant sheath supplies a literal container for latent fruit.
Interior bearing supplies a second concealed developmental state.
Delivery supplies emergence from the gestational enclosure.
Every knowable entity includes its latent, emerging, and manifest phases.
Knowledge from every side becomes temporal coverage of the whole process.

structural_cues: 41:47 coordinates the Hour's returned knowledge with every fruit emerging, every female bearing, and every birth occurring only with His knowledge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hidden containers, emergence, gestation, birth, and knowledge; I infer that محيط covers transitions as well as states. A live alternative is that the examples only enumerate hidden facts.

changed_reading.before: Encompassing means possessing a static inventory of all objects.
changed_reading.after: Encompassing tracks every thing through concealment, development, emergence, and return, so the hidden meeting is already inside a fully known process.

context_deltas.mechanism: The human subject swings with contact: harm cuts off hope, relief produces ownership claims and doubt of the Hour, and favor produces lateral withdrawal. This behavioral alternation activates the split م و ر branch under focus م ر ي, making مرية an enacted oscillation rather than only an inward proposition.

activation_trace.role: The impact of harm supplies the contact that triggers one pole of the oscillation.
Cut-off hope supplies the abrupt negative pole.
A second image of severed hope intensifies that pole rather than stabilizing it.
Unreliable supposition supplies the denial of the Hour during the favorable swing.
Conditional return supplies an admitted but destabilized route toward the Lord.
The speaker opportunistically claims my Lord while doubting the return.
Drawing the side away gives the favorable swing a bodily direction.
Sideways estrangement extends withdrawal into a relational posture.
The split-root wave image gathers the repeated reversals into the condition called مرية.
Actual convergence is the event their oscillating posture repeatedly approaches and evades.

structural_cues: 41:49-51 repeats touch, harm, relief, claim, conditional return, favor, lateral withdrawal, renewed harm, and prolonged appeal.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated fortune-conditioned reversals; I supply the arrow from those reversals to the non-dominant م و ر wave branch mapped under focus م ر ي. The materially live alternative is the direct lexical branch of doubt with no oscillatory coloring.

changed_reading.before: Their doubt is a stable intellectual opinion about resurrection.
changed_reading.after: Their مرية is also a lived back-and-forth posture, changing direction with each touch of harm or favor while never leaving the approaching encounter.

context_deltas.mechanism: The late sequence thickens doubt into interpenetrated uncertainty, perturbation, and far schism, then spans the far horizons and the self until truth discloses itself and witness is sufficient. The final verse collapses the attempted distance: they are not beyond the evidence but inside doubt, and both inner and outer fields are inside the encompassing.

activation_trace.role: Interpenetrating alternatives that prevent certainty supply the first late-surah doubt texture.
Perturbed suspicion makes that uncertainty actively unsettling.
Rupture by disagreement turns doubt into an alienated split.
Far horizons supply the outermost field across which signs appear.
The entity's own self supplies the corresponding innermost field.
Emergence into visibility supplies the transition from signs to disclosed truth.
Reality stable against falsehood supplies what the signs disclose.
Present witnessing places the Lord across the entire field of things.
The final verse relocates the late-surah uncertainty as an enclosure they inhabit.
Complete comprehension closes the horizon/self field around every thing.

structural_cues: 41:45 names شك مريب; 41:52 names شقاق بعيد; 41:53 crosses horizons and selves until truth becomes clear; 41:54 twice alerts that they are in doubt while He encompasses every thing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the progression from disturbed doubt through far split to outer/inner signs, disclosure, witness, and encompassing; I infer a collapse of attempted epistemic distance. The alternative is a set of adjacent claims without one spatial mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The final verse repeats a generic rebuke of disbelief.
changed_reading.after: It closes a spatial-epistemic sequence: far schism is crossed from horizons to selves, truth discloses itself, and their remaining doubt is exposed as an enclosure wholly inside divine witness and comprehension.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This uses the non-dominant ك ف ي to ك ف ف mapping, so it is form-distant and must not replace the ordinary sense of sufficiency. It remains packet-anchored because branch B006 literally supplies encompassing all immediately before repeated رب and كل شيء language, and downstream prose should present it only as a latent bridge into 41:54.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: 41:53 أَوَلَمْ يَكْفِ بِرَبِّكَ ... عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ شَهِيدٌ / 41:54 بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ مُّحِيطٌ

activation_trace.role: The split-root image of encompassing all unexpectedly turns sufficiency into a formal bridge toward the final enclosure.
The complete whole gives the split-root bridge the same scope as the next ayah.
Every knowable entity supplies the shared object of witness and encompassing.
Repeated lordship keeps the bridge attached to the same sovereign subject.
Complete comprehension realizes explicitly what the distant split branch only hinted.

changed_reading.before: 41:53 asserts sufficient witness and 41:54 independently asserts omniscience.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, sufficient witness already carries a hidden image of encompassing all, which the next ayah makes explicit.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The milking/extraction branch of م ر ي is far from the lexical sense of مِرْيَةٍ and is not a proposed translation. It remains anchored in the focus root and gains a visible mechanism from concealed fruit emerging and truth becoming manifest; downstream prose should render it only as an image of signs working on resistance until disclosure is drawn out.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: مِرْيَةٍ at focus root م ر ي, activated by hidden emergence and تَبَيُّن before the final encompassing

activation_trace.role: Extraction from concealment supplies a process analogue for latent truth becoming manifest.
The fruit sheath supplies the resistant container from which emergence occurs.
Truth's becoming manifest supplies the epistemic result of the extraction image.
Stroking to draw out what is held within supplies the odd but root-anchored image for pressure on their doubt.
Complete comprehension supplies the field within which concealed acknowledgment can be drawn into disclosure.

changed_reading.before: Doubt is only a sealed blockage left in place after the signs.
changed_reading.after: As a contained image, the signs work upon the enclosure of doubt until concealed recognition is drawn toward manifestation.

strongest_changes: The self-declared covers and barrier of 41:4-5 become smaller enclosures subsumed by the final encompassing.
Bodily witnesses in 41:19-23 turn the meeting into an embodied evidentiary encounter rather than an abstract future arrival.
Revival in 41:39-40 and hidden emergence in 41:47 make encompassing dynamic across death, restoration, concealment, and outcome.
The progression شك مريب to شقاق بعيد to signs in horizons and selves makes 41:54 collapse attempted distance into an enclosure within divine witness.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet exposed a sustained container-and-disclosure mechanism, while the split mappings م ر ي to م و ر and ك ف ي to ك ف ف preserved two controlled surprises: doubt as enacted oscillation and sufficiency as a latent bridge to encompassing all.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether محيط should foreground complete knowledge, spatial custody, protective care, or overwhelming seizure; the branch field keeps all four live.
How much weight downstream prose should give the non-dominant م و ر and ك ف ف activations beyond marking them as exploratory.
Whether لقاء is only the terminal resurrection encounter or also the culmination of an encounter already occurring through signs, witness, and disclosure.
